sanskrit_verse:
धर्मेणोद्धरतो राज्ञो व्यवहारान् कृतात्मनः
संभवन्ति गुणाः सप्त सप्त वह्नेरिवार्चिषः
transliteration:
dharmeṇoddharato rājño vyavahārān kṛtātmanaḥ
saṃbhavanti guṇāḥ sapta sapta vahner ivārciṣaḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: When a ruler upholds Dharma in all judicial acts with purified consciousness, sevenfold qualities manifest naturally—as flames arise from fire.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with Dharma, not institutional position
Causation originates in the sovereign integrity of the adjudicator
Capacity-based responsibility is realized through inner purification
Restoration logic operates via spontaneous dharmic unfoldment
Consciousness alignment determines the efficacy of justice delivery
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler's consciousness is aligned with Dharma THEN judicial outcomes are self-validating
IF adjudicator performs self-purification BEFORE judgment THEN sevenfold qualities auto-manifest
IF legal act originates in dharma-uplift THEN no external enforcement is required
IF judgment aligns with pramāṇa-based reality THEN consequences unfold organically
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, judgments must originate from rulers who have performed dharma-upholding purification. The court’s authority is validated not by precedent or procedure, but by the spontaneous manifestation of the sevenfold qualities—indicating alignment with the cosmic order.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya arises when the ruler’s consciousness is purified through dharma-uplift. Responsibility is not assigned externally but assumed internally through alignment. Consequences follow sequentially (anupūrvaśaḥ) based on causal purity, not punitive design. Justice is the natural flame of a burning fire—self-evident and self-sustaining.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Ruler undertakes dharma-based purification before adjudication
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Judgment arises from inner clarity, not coercive frameworks
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Sevenfold qualities are cultivated through sustained alignment
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Legal acts are validated by their dharmic resonance, not enforcement
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. Dharma is restored. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
